//==
// # Scene index types
//
// The zero-based typed indices that address into a Scene3D and its resource
// pools. A typed index can never be silently confused with another kind, and
// they all share one absence encoding.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Typed indices (Value is zero-based, and -1
// means "none" / "not present").

// A zero-based index of a node within Scene3D.Nodes. -1 means "none"
// (a root's parent).
type SceneNodeIndex3D
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}
